# SOLO-AGENT-RUNBOOK

<!-- generated by scripts/docs/generate_solo_agent_docs.py; edit source data in srl.labctl -->
A solo agent uses SRF by following receipts, not chat history.

## Entry

```bash
srlab labctl enter
srlab doctor
srlab catalog inspect
```

## Request

Prepare a JSON bundle containing one scientific request and one claim,
then run `srlab plan build <bundle-file>`. If a capability is missing,
the planner returns a typed WAIT state instead of selecting an unsafe
fallback.

## Execution

Run bounded work with `srlab run execute <run-spec-file>`. Exit code `0`
means a receipt was emitted. It does not validate the scientific claim.

## Recovery

Keep one writer, preserve evidence, retry only clear transients once,
and park protected or unavailable capabilities with exact WAIT states.
